faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 Assistant Technical Examiner, 1 Assistant Technical Examiner (Horticulture), 1 Junior Technical Examiner.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this notice) and send it to Under Secretary (Admn), Central Vigilance Commission, Satarkta Bhawan, Block-A, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi-110023, by through proper channel, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 7 of the 7th CPC (Rs. 44900 – 142400 ) for Assistant Technical Examiner, Level 7 of the 7th CPC (Rs. 44900 – 142400 ) for Assistant Technical Examiner (Horticulture), Level 6 in the pay matrix for Junior Technical Examiner.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers of the status of Assistant Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Horticulture) / Junior Engineer (with 3 years regular service in the grade) of the Government of India, or holding analogous posts in State Government or Union Territories offices; ATE and JTE need qualification and experience in Engineering/Diploma (Civil/Mechanical/Electrical/Materials Management). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only candidates who can be relieved immediately upon their selection. Application must come through proper channel. Appointment on deputation as per DoP&T's O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation period for ATE and ATE (Horticulture): ordinarily not exceeding 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I); Attested copies of the ACRs/APARs for the last five years; Certification that no disciplinary case is either contemplated or pending against the officer/official; Vigilance Clearance certificate; Employer certificate on integrity, immediate relief and major/minor penalties in last 10 years.
